build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: Gate D golden of an optical-era lounge room (I6 steps 3, 3b and 4, ADR-0014 §1 and §2, style 14.3, concept panel 4): the esde/case-shelves fixture's ps2 room on gen6 under the optical_era_lounge pack (dark blue walls over the walnut wainscot, a discreet blue against warm lamps), its 100 invented titles as DVD keep cases (disc_case_dvd_v2): the featured ones face-out in the two lit glass display cases and on the featured wall shelf, the hero modules' bookcases lit inside with a face-out band and cases standing on their side with their spines upright; the pack's era furniture: a low sofa facing the CRT, its back to the doorway, floor lamps, glass showcases of generic consoles on sideboards, a large framed poster, a small blue rug; the DVD HOME neon in the pack's blue; from the doorway (the room's doorway camera), the hero CRT showing its first game's cover (no clip: I5 step 1, ADR-0016 §3). Since I5 step 6 its screens through the pack's monitor CRT preset (a fine mask, little curvature).

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/case-shelves
